title: NASA Jupiter satellite sheet: Callisto (IV) mass 1075.9×10^20 kg, radius 2410.3 km
summary: The Jupiter satellite fact sheet lists Callisto (IV) at mass 1075.9 × 10^20 kg and radius 2410.3 km.
body: NASA's Jupiter satellite fact sheet lists Callisto (IV) with mass 1075.9 × 10^20 kg, radius 2410.3 km, mean density 1830 kg/m^3, and visual geometric albedo 0.19. Orbital parameters on the same sheet: Semi-major axis (10 3 km) = 1882.7; Semi-major axis (Jovian Radii) = 26.33; Orbital Period* (days) = 16.689017; Rotation Period (days) = S; Inclination (degrees) = 0.19; Eccentricity = 0.007. These are the cells printed on the sheet. The sheet does not say, on this row, which cells are a spacecraft measurement and which are an estimate. The sheet says R indicates retrograde motion, and S indicates synchronous rotation, the rotation period equal to the orbital period. Author of the sheet: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center. Last Updated line: 6 December 2023.
